original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.

actual_scope: Source-pinned induced Petersen-plus-four-isolates certificates for both selected P111 and pinned P112: block fitting rank at least 9d over every field, equality in characteristic two, and exact nonlinear zero-error binary broadcast length 9d for every positive block size d.
scope_change_reason: The helper-inventory investigation raised a necessary rank-eight label premise. This side result isolates the obstruction, strengthens it to all block sizes and binary nonlinear coding, and identifies its known Petersen-theorem basis; it supplies no new helper inventory.
bottleneck_link: Closes below-nine fitting compression of this exact graph over every field and binary nonlinear broadcast compression at every block size. A positive supplier must change the graph/constraints or save other paid work; no kappa improvement follows.
stop_rule: Finish this side result after source-pinned embedding, exact rational dual, independent characteristic-two proof, registered replays, and explicit prior-art/scope checks. Include the directly checked selected-P111 reflection corollary.
evidence: Four eight-cliques on 14 vertices have odd incidence at a four-clique, proving 4d<=4(r-8d) in characteristic two. The induced usual fitting graph is four isolates plus Petersen. A 113-term exact rational certificate proves the known Petersen bound five and extends the full lower bound to all fields and nonlinear zero-error codes. Independent standard-library replays check all 2912 required-zero pairs, 12544 binary Gram entries, all 1024 dual coefficients, a matching positive fixture, and 15 corruption controls. A separate checker proves the selected P111 corollary by an exact coordinate reflection of the fourteen-vertex witness, verifies all 2,870 required-zero pairs and 12,321 binary Gram entries, and rejects six further corruptions. The nonlinear reduction fixes 97 outside messages for P111.

open_questions.question: Can a changed graph or changed native interface improve a complete paid supplier budget?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The fixed graph cannot be compressed below nine using scalar or block-linear fitting matrices over any field, nor nonlinear zero-error binary codes. Savings must change those constraints or remove other paid work.
open_questions.first_step: Specify the changed graph or native constraints and derive a complete optimistic paid budget before constructing a circuit.
open_questions.blocked_by: No compatible native word, restoration/phase proof or global owner invoice for a changed interface is supplied here.
